title: Purpose-separated A-signed pre-finalization member live lease (draft)
description: Ed25519 signs ASCII purpose agent-bot/stage2a-member-live-lease/v1, one NUL byte and exact RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 payload bytes. The issuer field is not a trust anchor; wrappers open and verify the fixed root-owned installed A public key. A stale, wrong-member, repeated-sequence or missing signed two-child observation refuses. This does not release ACP input or provider ingress.
